scripts.dev: npm run build -w @trip-planner/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @trip-planner/shared" "npm run dev -w @trip-planner/server" "npm run dev -w @trip-planner/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trip-planner/shared && npm run build -w @trip-planner/client && npm run build -w @trip-planner/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @trip-planner/shared && npm run test -w @trip-planner/server && npm run test -w @trip-planner/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @trip-planner/shared && npm run typecheck -w @trip-planner/server && npm run typecheck -w @trip-planner/client
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
